messages:
Maria (oncall): incident-bot alerted: eu-west /v1/chat endpoints showing sustained 5xx surge, 20m avg error ~14% :rotating_light:
Incident-bot: Severity=P1 · Impact=partial-region · Affected=/v1/chat, /v1/generate (eu-west)
Maria (oncall): taking ownership. tagging runbooks. @Rupert can you eyeball provider telemetry? suspect provider-A backends.
Tyler: jumping in. provider-A shows connection resets + load spikes at L7; p50->p95 latency widening. Also seeing TLS session churn.
Rupert (eng-sre): agree. before full failover we should try targeted traffic pressure relief and feature gating. full region failover is riskier for KV-cache cold misses.
Anita (prod-eng): we can flip a feature gate to stop 'heavy-analytics' and 'plugin-exec' for eu-west instantly. that should drop token load by ~15-25% based on last week's profile.
Jamal (cs): heads-up — top customers might notice degraded throughput. I'll prepare a short customer note, will hold until we confirm duration.
Maria (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) apply short-term per-client rate-shedding for top chat tenants 2) brownout non-essential features in eu-west 3) progressively shift traffic to Provider-B with canary 4) monitor and keep premium SLAs exempt
Tyler: running quick top-talkers query:

```
SELECT client_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens FROM requests
WHERE region = 'eu-west' AND ts > now() - interval '10 minutes'
GROUP BY client_id ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 8;
```

Tyler: list ready. propose 40% cap on top two clients for 15m, 25% on next three, and a lighter 10% on the rest in top-8. keep verbose logging for them.
Maria (oncall): applying policy via redwoodctl now:

```
redwoodctl traffic apply --region eu-west --policy /ops/policies/temp-shed-euw.yaml
```

Maria (oncall): policy applied. watchers: @Tyler @Anita. starting feature brownout.
Anita (prod-eng): toggling flags in eu-west:

```
flagsmith set --env eu-west --flag heavy-analytics false
flagsmith set --env eu-west --flag plugin-exec false
```

Anita (prod-eng): flags flipped. dashboard shows token throughput down ~19% and errors starting to decline.
Rupert (eng-sre): initiating canary shift to Provider-B at 10% traffic via smart-routing. keeping 15% pinned to Provider-A for warm validation.
Deploy-bot: Routing-change: canary to provider-b initiated (10% -> eu-west).
Tyler: watching provider-B backends for cache-warm behavior; if cold-hit rate > 2x baseline we'll throttle the routing ramp.
Maria (oncall): canary looks clean at 10% for 3m. increasing to 40%.
Rupert (eng-sre): 40% steady. error-rate down to ~4.5%. beginning graceful drain on unhealthy Provider-A nodes.
Tyler: p99 on routed traffic dropped from 2.4s -> 1.5s. overall errors trending down.
Jamal (cs): Major client Orion is in top-two. recommending temporary quota exception to preserve their SLAs while others get shed. want to send comms if we hold throttles >20m.
Maria (oncall): applying exemption for Orion:

```
redwoodctl quota adjust --client orion --region eu-west --delta +25% --duration 40m
```

Maria (oncall): exemption applied.
Rupert (eng-sre): draining provider-A nodes gracefully:

```
kubectl label pod provider-a-17 redwood/drain=begin
```

Rupert (eng-sre): also enabling connection rebalancing to reduce new sessions to provider-A.
Tyler: edge circuit-breakers not tripping. tail latency for edge proxies up slightly but within thresholds.
Anita (prod-eng): brownout holding; internal downstream queues shrinking. looks like we bought back error budget.
Maria (oncall): error rate now ~0.8% at last check. continuing controlled ramp to Provider-B. keeping throttle policy for another 20m minimum.
Rupert (eng-sre): quick heads-up — I need a 25m handoff. @Tyler you'll take primary while I'm out. @Maria you're still incident owner.
Maria (oncall): acknowledged. Tyler please carry the runbook during that window.
Tyler: ack. I'll monitor KV-cache miss rate and provider B latency. if misses exceed threshold I'll trigger a short cache-warm traffic burst.
PagerDuty: Rupert acknowledged incident. Next on-call: Tyler.
-- ~27 minutes later --
Tyler: status update: error rate stable ~0.5%, p99 improved further. removing some of the lighter caps (10% group).

```
redwoodctl traffic update --region eu-west --policy-id temp-shed --remove-clients light-cap
```

Tyler: restoring heavy-analytics for core customers gradually. experimental routing remains disabled.
Anita (prod-eng): restoring feature: heavy-analytics -> true for core-tier. plugins still off until final green.
Maria (oncall): prepping timeline for postmortem and assigning owners: Anita + Tyler = technical writeup; Jamal = customer comms. postmortem meeting in 2.5h.
Jamal (cs): drafted message for customers; will only publish if caps persist beyond 25m. includes status page link and mitigation summary.
Rupert (eng-sre): I'm back online. observed handover notes and will join postmortem. good mitigation.
Maria (oncall): summary: root cause likely provider-A session/connection churn triggered by a config rollout, causing elevated 5xxs. mitigation: targeted client shedding + feature brownout + progressive provider reroute. impact: partial degradation in eu-west ~35m, most premium traffic preserved. follow-up ticket created INC-5432 for RCA and provider remediation.
Incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Follow-up task INC-5432 created.
Maria (oncall): closing incident channel, moving to post-incident doc. thanks team :heart:
